339-677-7175-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2105-3480-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1981-2415-6495-6794.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-6794.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

560-4550-6798-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-6798-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Repeat.

4559-5147-5184-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
4559-5147-5184-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2021-2060-4772-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

862-3558-4668-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-3558-4668-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1594-4200-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2301-2438-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2301-2438-2946-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3480-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3480-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-5470-6791-6797.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1402-1903-2218-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1491-4289-6218-7267.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1274-4659-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-4659-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

2060-2744-5256-5660--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2060-2744-5256-5660--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2744-5256-5660--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

643-997-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-997-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

339-413-677-955.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

165-1069-5295-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-5295-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

254-1947-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
254-1947-3327-4613.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat from step 2.

2018-3967--73.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
2018-3967--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

56-5075-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-5075-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Ogre Slumlord and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-5075-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

803-3951-5686-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
803-3951-5686-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2397-4374-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
2397-4374-5870.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E} and gain 2 life.
Repeat.

745-1621.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry.
745-1621.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Mirrorhall Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Mirrorhall Mimic. Choose to have Mirrorhall Mimic enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

2595-4613-5507.notablePrerequisites:
You control another creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4613-5507.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it this turn.
Activate another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by exiling it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Repeat step 2 using the Human token instead.

4659-4772-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-4772-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating four Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

1115-3259-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
1115-3259-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1707-3899-4776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1707-3899-4776.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Last Laugh's first ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sprouting Phytohydra triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat, sacrificing the damaged Sprouting Phytohydra instead.

232-307-2232-3612.notablePrerequisites: Priest of Urabrask does not have summoning sickness.
232-307-2232-3612.description:
Declare Priest of Urabrask as an attacker.
Arni Metalbrow triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R} to put Thousand-Faced Shadow from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it, Arni Metalbrow and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Arni Metalbrow trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the Thousand-Faced Shadow trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it, Arni Metalbrow and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Thousand-Faced Shadow to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Arni Metalbrow trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to put Thousand-Faced Shadow from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 3.

1885-2639-4050-4125.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Mitotic Slime and Shipwreck Dowser, adding {W}{W}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {G}{G}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Eerie Ultimatum by paying {W}{W}{B}{B}{B}{G}{G}, returning Shipwreck Dowser and Mitotic Slime to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eerie Ultimatum from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1475-2034-5003.notablePrerequisites: Nim Deathmantle attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
1475-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Nim Deathmantle attached, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle and One with the Kami.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating at least two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1475-2816-4050.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Umbral Mantle attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
1475-2816-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Umbral Mantle attached, adding one mana of any color.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

1082-1734.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Dual Nature's first ability.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
The token Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering Dual Nature's second ability, exiling the Fiend Hunter token.
The Fiend Hunter token leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
